verdict.rationale: PostHog documents several of its own autonomous background automations: event-triggered no-code Workflows with delays and actions, the Self-driving loop where scouts emit signals and agents investigate and open PRs without prompting, Desktop Cloud agents that keep working after the app closes, and scheduled batch exports. These are recurring and triggered processes, not one-off actions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automations run reliably (the evidence is first-party docs and self-reported dogfooding).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You decide when a workflow is triggered, who it reaches, and what happens at each step – triggers, delays, audience splits, message sends, and PostHog actions.
It runs as a loop. Scouts and signal sources emit signals, signals group into reports, and an agent investigates each report.
Cloud for work that should continue after you close the app.
Batch exports give you a platform to schedule data exports to supported destinations.
